Open-source packages I am a collaborator on.

## [NCL.jl](https://github.com/JuliaSmoothOptimizers/NCL.jl)

A pure-Julia implementation of [Algorithm NCL](https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-319-90026-1_8)
(Ma, Judd, Orban and Saunders) for nonlinearly constrained optimization, part of the
[JuliaSmoothOptimizers](https://jso.dev) ecosystem. NCL is a stabilized augmented-Lagrangian
method that solves a short sequence of subproblems regularized by residual variables, which
keeps it reliable on problems that violate the LICQ. Its subproblems are solved by
interior-point methods such as IPOPT, Artelys Knitro and MadNLP. I made the solver
integrations optional package extensions, added support for maximization problems and
Julia LTS, made NCL declare infeasibility at the maximum penalty, and tuned how barrier
parameters are passed to MadNLP and Knitro.

## [JuliaNeutrino](https://github.com/JuliaNeutrino)

A GitHub organization I created for neutrino physics in Julia. Its core is
[GLoBES.jl](https://github.com/JuliaNeutrino/GLoBES.jl), a Julia implementation of
[GLoBES](https://www.mpi-hd.mpg.de/personalhomes/globes/), the General Long Baseline
Experiment Simulator for neutrino oscillation experiments. Around it sit
[SNOwGLoBES.jl](https://github.com/JuliaNeutrino/SNOwGLoBES.jl) and
[SupernovaNeutrinos.jl](https://github.com/JuliaNeutrino/SupernovaNeutrinos.jl), Julia ports
of SNOwGLoBES and SNEWPY for supernova neutrino models, flavor transformations and event
rates, and new-physics extensions for scalar and vector non-standard interactions,
environmental decoherence and neutrino mass models. Each package has a Colab notebook
that runs it end to end.
